3. Changed the green block positions

# ACTION7 changed the board significantly. Let me check the current state.
seg = current_frame.segmentation
print("Objects:")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['pixels'] > 1:
        rows = [p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
        cols = [p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        print(f"  {n['color']}: ({min(rows)},{min(cols)})-({max(rows)},{max(cols)}), {n['pixels']}px")

# Click all green blocks
green = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"\nGreen blocks: {len(green)}")
clicks = []
for g in green:
    rows = [p[0] for p in g['boundary']]
    cols = [p[1] for p in g['boundary']]
    cr = sum(rows)//len(rows)
    cc = sum(cols)//len(cols)
    clicks.append({'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': cr, 'col': cc})
    print(f"  Click green at ({cr},{cc})")

action(clicks)
seg = current_frame.segmentation
green = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
pink = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'P']
blue = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'S']
print(f"\nAfter: Green={len(green)}, Pink={len(pink)}, Blue={len(blue)}")
print(f"Completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
print(f"Game over: {last_action_result.get('game_over')}")

        rows = [p[0] for p in p['boundary']]
        cols = [p[1] for p in p['boundary']]
        cr = sum(rows)//len(rows)
        cc = sum(cols)//len(cols)
        print(f"\nClicking pink at ({cr},{cc})")
        action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': cr, 'col': cc}])
    
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    green = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
    pink = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'P']
    blue = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'S']
    print(f"\nAfter pink: Green={len(green)}, Pink={len(pink)}, Blue={len(blue)}")
    print(f"Completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
    print(f"Game over: {last_action_result.get('game_over')}")
